name: Construction, Resource Costs, Building Progress & Settlement Expansion Runtime
design_rules: construction consumes explicit physical resources from inventory
building progress advances through ordered stages rather than instant placement
labor tools and material availability constrain progress
partial construction persists across world time
repairs consume resources and restore condition instead of resetting for free
upgrades modify existing structures without duplicating them
settlement expansion depends on completed infrastructure capacity
construction never uses emissive or glow feedback
